name: Eclipse
idea: An observatory: your business comes out of the shadow, and amber is the only source of light.
place: On its landing page, its client portal and its proposals

corona.name: Corona
corona.use: The light: one action per screen

display.role: One big serif moment per section

text.role: Interface, body copy and the ECLIPSE wordmark
text.sample: Websites, systems and AI agents: before we talk, we show you your business already working.

grid: A 24-unit square: the sun has a radius of 6.5; the corona, 8.6.
The glint sits on the diagonal, at 45°, between the sun and the corona.
The wordmark is centred on the disc's axis, with half an em between letters.

alt.logo: Eclipse logo: a total eclipse with its amber corona and the word ECLIPSE under it
alt.secondary: Horizontal version, as in the header: the eclipse beside the word ECLIPSE
alt.submark: Eclipse symbol: the ring of the corona with its glint
alt.patterns: Three patterns: phases of the eclipse, instrument rulers and discs in occultation on amber
alt.post: Sample post: a total eclipse and the line Your business, in full light
alt.story: Sample story: Websites, Systems, Content, All connected and the Get your demo button
alt.poster: Sample poster on light paper: the observatory dial and We show you your business already working
alt.print: Sample project passport, in amber: the five stages, with the second one lit
alt.object: Welcome box in 3D: the eclipse on the front, an amber lid, rulers on the sides

source: The eclipse, the wordmark, the colours and the typefaces come from Eclipse's repo. The grid, the patterns, the pieces and the box were drawn for this board, as samples.
